init.label: Choice Ladder
init.body:
# Choosing several options at once
A **Decision Matrix** ranks options. When you can only do some of them, the **Choice Ladder** orders them. The band is the value you get, and each card takes its share. Where two scores are close it forks; pick either side and the plan follows.

init.label: Policy agenda
init.body:
### Policy agenda
Capital has no total, so the ladder is the order to spend it in. Small business relief earns capital back. The child tax credit was promised, so it's a Must; the oversight board is off the table. Fuel levy and Fuel tax holiday exclude each other; Transit expansion requires Zoning reform.
